entry.name: gen_dsp_t60time
entry.digest: Return a given t60 time (in samples) for a given multiplication factor
entry.description: Estimates the decay time (in samples) of a given decay factor. That is, given a multiplier X, returns a number T such that, after T multiplications of a signal by X, that signal would be attenuated by 60 decibels. It is the dual of the t60 object.
